Elena: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A. Need short answers so teams can move: 1) What is the single-line positioning we should use against cloud AI endpoints? 2) What concrete signals trigger an upsell to Dedicated? 3) Which region is next for Private? 4) Any immediate discount/table changes?

Noah: Single-line: 'Redwood = predictable inference economics + production-grade serving across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments.' Keep it focused on serving not models.

Sergio: Dedicated upsell triggers: sustained >60 days of steady spend, repeated rate-limit complaints, or strict latency p95 <= 250ms needs. Offer a 30-60 day reserved pilot.

Tara: Regional priority: EU first for Private, APAC after we finish a couple cloud-region launches.

Elena: Discounts?

Noah: No immediate change. Use existing commit tiers; RevOps will finalize any exception. We'll publish a one-pager mapping tiers to expected latencies and costs.

infra-bot: Note: follow-up doc uploaded https://internal.redwood.ai/docs/all-hands/2330000001-summary.pdf

Elena: Thanks 44d I'll distribute to PMs and AE leads.
